Shaikhspeare is aiming to hit the road, perform in different cities in India starting with some of the west zone cities, meet and greet his fans and give them an immersive experience of the album, authentic bombay hiphop sound and the message his music carries.  

Supporting Acts for each cities to be announced soon! 

About Artist- 

"Aamir Shaikh", better known as "Shaikhspeare" aka "Shaikh The Don" is a rapper/songwriter based out of Mumbai, India and is deemed as one of the OGs who has been representing Bombay rap scene & Indian underground hiphop for more than a decade.

events.title: Zoo Gathering
events.description:
Digital Dialogue Presents - 🦁ZOO DEEP TRIP GATHERING!

💥After the unforgettable roar of last year’s Zoo Festival a gathering that brought the tribe together & left the dancefloor buzzing long after the music🎵 faded we return with the next chapter of the journey.🦄

Deep Trip ZOO Gathering is not just an event, it’s a celebration of the roots a true 📀Old Goa Trance experience where psychedelic storytelling, timeless grooves & raw energy meet under the open sky.🔥 Last year proved what happens when the right people, the right sound, & the right intention come together pure magic, unity, & memories etched into the night.👁️

🧚🏻‍♀️This February, we dive deeper.
Expect retro Goa frequencies, long hypnotic journeys, & a dancefloor that moves as one surrounded by wild visuals👁️ tribal energy, & that unmistakable old-school vibe that started it all. This is for the heads who remember, the souls who feel, & the new generation ready to experience 🌴Goa trance in its truest form.
The ZOO opens its gates once again.💥

The journey continues.🐾
